data.gender_notes: Jahanzeb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jahanzeb is a name of Arabic and Urdu origin that means 'given by Allah'. It is a beautiful name that symbolizes majesty, generosity, and being gifted by the Almighty. The name Jahanzeb carries the meaning “Majestic, Generous, Gifted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Jahanzeb usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, generous, gifted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jahanzeb is a name that reflects the spiritual significance of being a gift from Allah. It is a reminder of the blessings that come from the divine and the importance of living a life that honors these blessings.
data.etymology: Jahanzeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Generous, Gifted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jahanzeb total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جَهَانزَب
in_arabic.meaning: جَاهَنزَبُ: المُتَضَرِّعُ الَّذي يُجَمِّعُ أَمانَاتَ النَّاسِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: جَاهَنزَبُ: المُتَضَرِّعُ الَّذي يُجَمِّعُ أَمانَاتَ النَّاسِ، وَالَّذي يُجمَعُ لَهُ الأَمانَاتُ، وَالَّذي يُجمَعُ لَهُ المالُ، وَالَّذي يُجمَعُ لَهُ الشُكرُ، وَالَّذي يُجمَعُ لَهُ الصِفاتُ. يُعتَبرُ جَهَانزَبَ أَحَدَ أَسَمِياتِ الرِجالِ الصَالِحينَ، وَالَّذي يُجمَعُ لَهُ المَعانيُ وَالَّذي يُجمَعُ لَهُ الأَخلاقُ. وَالجِهانُ: السَماطُ، وَالزَب: الذُبّانُ. ويُضافُ إلى الاسمِ مَعنًى: المُتَضَرِّعُ المَجدِيُّ. وَقَد يُكَفِّرُ الَّذي يُسمى بِهِ وَلَو بَينَ الشُكرِ وَالثَناءِ.
